audit.why: The field exists to hold real numbers; this one is vague filler plus a misplaced self-reference.
audit.corrected: Replaced with Ezreal's real E/Q/R cooldown numbers and what each window means.

audit.why: missingInteractions is empty for this matchup; the page already covers the Arcane Shift bait/punish window and the Mystic Shot poke exchange, both grounded in real ability names.

edits.before: - Ezreal Arcane Shift: matchup-defining — The blink makes him untouchable — punish the nineteen seconds after he burns it. Check it before every step-up. - E Beat Drop is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: Arcane Shift (E) is 26s at rank 1, dropping to 14s at max — punish the whole window after he burns it, not just early. Mystic Shot (Q) is 5.5-4.5s and shortens further on hit. Trueshot Barrage sits at 120-90s — bait it, don't eat it.

edits.before: Echoed Q the contact, W the trade-back, E the disengage — the song taxed, healed, and rooted in one verse.
edits.after: Beat Drop (E) roots in a line; land it right after your support's slow before he blinks out with Arcane Shift.

edits.before: Spending the echo on a plain W out of rhythm — the third note is the champion; wasting it is singing scales.
edits.after: Your W only shields at 800 range — step past it and Mystic Shot pokes you for free with no answer.

notes: suspectNames flagged Mystic Shot(s) and Arcane Shift as possibly wrong (edit-distance false positives from pluralization/phrasing) — checked against enemyKit, both names are correct, left alone. tldr and report[0].t 'doubles what' phrasing was flagged as unsupported magnitude but is describing Seraphine's own kit mechanic (every third spell casts twice), not an Ezreal number, so no source is needed or missing; left as-is.
